last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for ignition occurrence identities. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); no new user setting or workflow requires a guide. decisions.rationale: Prevents stale callbacks from mutating a newer ignition occurrence; existing ignition settings and tuning workflow are unchanged.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Closes ignition occurrences atomically, rejects obsolete callbacks and preserves charged-output discharge.
